name: myhomelab
description: Self-hosted control panel for a Proxmox home lab, with a team of AI agents (Claude) that study, install and verify updates, organise Gmail and more.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,backend,frontend -c gray,blue,green "npm run dev -w @myhomelab/shared" "npm run start:dev -w @myhomelab/backend" "npm run dev -w @myhomelab/frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run start:dev -w @myhomelab/backend
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @myhomelab/frontend
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @myhomelab/backend && npm run build -w @myhomelab/frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @myhomelab/backend && npm run lint -w @myhomelab/frontend
